integrity: Exact modular polynomial identities and resultant certificates are independently recomputable by bundled code; no independent expert validation claimed.
limitations: Exactly ten marked parameters in this two-dimensional smooth family, not ten abstract isomorphism classes (only two abstract superspecial genus-two classes in characteristic eleven are known).
The length-fifteen boundary scheme is defined only by extending Cartier-entry equations to singular sextics; no singular curve Jacobian is asserted.
Equivalent computations under other moduli coordinates or in uninspected historical literature remain possible.
title: Ten reduced superspecial parameters and a length-15 boundary collision in characteristic eleven
